تستهلكوا (form X)
# تَسْتَهْلِكُوا (tastahlikū) /tas.tah.li.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# تُسْتَهْلَكُوا (tustahlakū) /tus.tah.la.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
